error_signature: Running gateway source remained the previous published source after staged Compose build
root_cause: The staging Compose invocation resolved the relative build context through the existing environment/project directory, despite an absolute compose file path.
fix: Use a private staging override with an absolute verified source context for the three owned service builds. Preserve published ports, networks, readonly/capability boundaries; supply the already documented PID creation flag. Verify actual image sources before acceptance.
